text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you currently have any blood in your urine, and is the flank pain felt on one side or both? Also, has your fever been persistent or does it come and go?

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Blood Culture, and Renal Ultrasound.

Since your urine appears normal and you lack typical urinary symptoms, I need these results to rule out an allergic interstitial reaction to your antibiotics or an occult infection.

Do you have any other symptoms like a new skin rash, joint pain, or swelling in your legs?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis shows Leukocyturia (Present) and Cytospin Stained With Hansel’s Solution reveals 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm. Note: Blood Culture and Renal Ultrasound results were not provided in the available data; please refer to NORMAL READINGS for those specific tests if no abnormalities were reported, though the current data strongly suggests Acute Interstitial Nephritis.
